description.value:
Canon gives Baraggan no Segunda Etapa; his Resurrección is already treated as the end state. This form extrapolates from what canon does establish: Respira ages everything it touches, including attacks aimed at him and the ground he stands on, and Baraggan can control its speed.

Respira becomes permanent and free. You emit a 20-foot emanation of aging miasma for as long as the Segunda Etapa lasts. Enemies that end their turn in it take @Damage[3d6[void]] damage (basic Fortitude) and are enfeebled 1 for 1 round on a failure.

Your decay consumes what is aimed at you. When a creature within the emanation targets you with an attack or a spell, it must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the attack or spell ages to nothing before it lands and has no effect. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to this flat check for 1 minute.
